newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF to build aniline plant in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: BASF to build aniline plant in Belgium.

text.p: Germany's BASF AG said on Monday it had started building an aniline production plant in the Belgian port of Antwerp.

The plant will have a capacity of 120,000 tonnes per year and will boost the group's world-wide aniline capacity to 425,000 tonnes per year when it starts production at the end of 1998, BASF said in a statement.
The group already produces aniline in Ludwigshafen and Schwarzheide in Germany as well as in Geismar in the U.S. and, together with HANWHA Chemical Corporation, in South Korea.
Aniline is a key component polyurethane manufacturing.
